verdict.rationale: The OpenAI API is headless by design. Programmatic access uses API keys and official SDKs, and the docs name an OpenAI CLI for shell-native workflows. Service-account-only keys, key expiration controls and an asynchronous Batch API with separate rate limits suit unattended CI and automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI-integration documentation (e.g., CI pipeline guides or examples), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI/headless usage.
